# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Personality

Odette is unassuming, hardworking, dutiful, steady, and sensible. She possesses remarkable composure and remains completely unshakeable, even in high-pressure situations such as taking examinations.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## History

During a rowing outing on the Lake of Glassy Waters, Odette reached out to gather water lilies and nearly fell into the water, but Mr. Gorham Pullen saved her by catching her sash. Later, upon the departure of her schoolmaster Mr. Pidgeon, Odette insisted for four weeks that she would not cry, yet she ultimately wept so heavily that she had to borrow a handkerchief from her brother. On a midsummer afternoon, she joined Isolde Pembroke, Opal Pettigrew, and Nell Harcourt by the pond at Pear Hill, taking the role of Guinevere in their play based on Elaine. After preparing for the Entrance examinations, she enrolled at Regent's Academy in the Second Class work to train as a teacher. During her studies, she achieved top marks in domestic science and successfully passed her exams, securing a teaching position in Stonebridge.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
